channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Healthy Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified healthy food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Top Pick: Panera: $4.99 Mix & Match Value Menu
item.description: Half- and cup-sized portions of soups, salads, and sandwiches from a 10-item menu for $4.99 each, and every item comes with a free side (baguette, chips, or apple). Pair any two for a full meal under $10 - in cafes and online, no membership needed. (Ongoing)

item.title: Top Pick: Noodles & Company: Delicious Duos from $9.95
item.description: Pick a small entree with a protein plus a side, served all day at a fixed price starting at $9.95. (Ongoing)

item.title: Chili's: 3 For Me from $10.99
item.description: Pick a non-alcoholic drink, a starter, and a full entree (burgers, crispers or more) for one flat price starting at $10.99, available all day dine-in, pickup or delivery. (Ongoing)

item.title: Subway: Deli Faves 6 inch subs for $3.99, Sub of the Day meal for $6.99
item.guid: Subway-Deli Faves 6 inch subs for $3.99, Sub of-2026-09-07
item.description: Subway's nationwide Fresh Value Menu offers four Deli Faves 6 inch subs and Protein Pockets for $3.99, plus a Sub of the Day 6 inch meal with chips and a drink for $6.99. (Ongoing)

item.title: Subway: Any Footlong for $6.99
item.description: Free Sub Club members can get any Footlong sub (excluding Fresh Fit, Deli Faves, 5 Meat Italian and Big Hot Pastrami) for $6.99 through the app or site, free account required. (Through September 29, 2026)

item.title: El Pollo Loco: $5 Fire-Grilled Combos: Rotating Value Menu
item.guid: El Pollo Loco-$5 Fire-Grilled Combos: Rotating Value M-2026-09-07
item.description: A rotating lineup of roughly $5 combos (Original Pollo Bowl, Classic Chicken Burrito, taquitos and more) built on citrus-marinated fire-grilled chicken, every day at participating locations. Lineup and pricing vary by market. (West & Southwest only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Subway: Sub of the Day 6 inch for $4.99
item.guid: Subway-Sub of the Day 6 inch for $4.99-2026-09-07
item.description: A different featured six inch sub is $4.99 every day as part of Subway's new Fresh Value Menu, with chips and a drink for $2 more. (Ongoing)

item.title: Subway: Protein Pocket for $3.99
item.description: A customizable protein wrap with over 20 grams of protein is $3.99 as part of Subway's Fresh Value Menu, available nationwide. (Ongoing)

item.title: Shake Shack: App-Exclusive $4 Fries and $2 Sodas
item.description: Order online through the Shake Shack app or website chain-wide for $4 Fries and $2 Sodas at participating locations, an app-only price versus regular menu. (Ongoing)
